Description: Infection of susceptible humans by infectious mosquitoes at rate β_H * S^H * I^V
Progression from latent to infectious period in humans at rate α_H * E^H
Recovery of infectious humans at rate γ * I^H
Infection of susceptible mosquitoes by infectious humans at rate β_V * S^V * I^H / N
Death of susceptible mosquitoes at rate δ * S^V, balanced by constant birth rate δ
Progression from extrinsic incubation to infectious in mosquitoes at rate α_V * E^V
Death of exposed mosquitoes at rate δ * E^V (included in the outflow)
Death of infectious mosquitoes at rate δ * I^V

Name: 1/α_H
Description: Intrinsic (human) incubation/latent period, prior Gamma(μ=5.9, σ=0.5)

Name: 1/α_V
Description: Extrinsic (vector) incubation period, prior Gamma(μ=10.5, σ=0.5)

Name: 1/γ
Description: Human infectious period, prior Gamma(μ=5, σ=0.5)

Name: r
Description: Proportion of cases reported (both symptomatic and asymptomatic that seek treatment)

Name: ϕ
Description: Reporting dispersion parameter for negative binomial distribution

Name: R_0
Description: Basic reproduction number, R_0 = (β_V * α_V * β_H) / (γ * (δ + α_V) * δ)
